CP-01.name: 核心 ETF 回撤分档
CP-01.interpretation: 评价回撤分档触发后对应 ETF 的前瞻表现；只做研究验证，不改变分档阈值。

CP-02.name: TQQQ / QQQ 回调杠杆情境
CP-02.interpretation: CP-02 的降低风险与恢复风险必须分开评价；使用 QQQ 作为状态机评价序列，不把 TQQQ 杠杆收益混进同一成绩。

CP-03.name: LEAPS Opportunity
CP-03.interpretation: 只评价标的走势，不伪造 LEAPS 合约 P&L；真实期权收益必须等合约级数据。

guardrails: Forward Trigger records remain the source of truth.
This foundation does not write an Outcome stream during the 10-session stabilization window.
Historical replay and Forward outcomes must remain separately labeled.
Baseline price is revalidated against local point-in-time history before scoring.
A baseline mismatch is quarantined rather than silently rescored.
No outcome result may automatically change production thresholds, position sizing, Hard Exit rules, or place orders.
